The '''''Death Merchant''''' was a [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transport]] owned by the [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenger]] [[Arns Grimraker]]. Grimraker ran a large salvage operation out of the ''Death Merchant'', which allowed him to move quickly and quietly between battlefields to claim the choicest finds before the competition.<ref name="hoth" /> Grimraker lost the ''Death Merchant'' while scavenging after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]&mdash;[[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], who had been left behind on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] in the chaos of the evacuation, stole the craft out from under Grimraker's nose to escape the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Damaged in the ensuing chase, the ''Death Merchant'' and Antilles were later picked up by an Alliance crew.<ref name="sw78" />
